name: PT WEHA Transportasi Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT WEHA Transportasi Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, provides passenger transportation services in Indonesia. It operates in three segments: Passenger Transportation Services, Inter-Cities Transportation Services, and Other Services. The company manages integrated land transportation services, including airport handling, wedding, employee shuttle, MICE transportation, and school bus transportation services. It also provides bus chartering; intercity shuttle and package delivery services; public transportation; car rental; and tour services, including open and private trips.
